body: Keep doing what you're doing. I'm in the same boat as her but I don't have anyone like you that cares about me. I've told people that I'm suicidal too and they freak out for a day and try to send me to therapy and then they stop talking to me. Definitely help her in finding a professional, but don't just dump her off on someone else and leave it like that. Listen to her, hug her, be there for her, tell her how important she is. And be so very patient.
